include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/ntoskrnl/include)

# The usbhub .c bodies are replaced by Rust (usbhub-rust). .c files kept on disk (never-delete).
# Bar: link-clean x3 (NOT boot-loaded in smoke -- boots from CD/ramdisk, not USB).

# usbhub.sys is all Rust (usbhub-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/usbhub-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
add_cargo_module(usbhub usbhub-cargo usbhub.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE usbhub-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk libntoskrnl libhal libwmilib libusbd)
